input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual and the carve-outs in 21.3 (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) plus the mutual exclusion of indirect damages in 21.2 and the payment-obligations carve-out all meet the preferred position. However, the cap basis fails the fallback: "Fees" is defined (1.5/1.6) as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the twelve-month reference captures no subscription or services charges. That is an illusory cap far below 6 months' actual fees — walk-away territory under the rule. The redline keys the cap to all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding 12 months, with a USD 1,000,000 floor, leaving the existing carve-outs untouched.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Because "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, the cap is illusory rather than the 12 months' fees our playbook requires; we have keyed it to all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding 12 months, with a USD 1,000,000 floor. Indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud remain outside the cap as Excluded Claims.
proposal.summary: Replace illusory implementation-fee cap with greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000.
